verses.8:15: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا لَقِيتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ زَحۡفࣰ ا فَلَا تُوَلُّوهُمُ ٱلۡأَدۡبَارَ

meaning: The root زحف (zHf) primarily describes slow, gradual movement, like a child crawling or an army advancing cautiously.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
